ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Extremely low macro-level ratio; the visible surface is predominantly composed of low-intensity pixels (black/dark grey) with sparse high-intensity (white) speckling covering less than 5% of the total fluke area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dispersed, fine-grained greyish-white pixel clusters throughout the central and outer lobes; no large-scale, high-contrast contiguous geometric blobs or solid banding are present.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Shallow V-shaped central depression dividing the lobes with a high obtuse interior angle and minimal pixel-depth penetration into the fluke body.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous trailing edge boundary exhibits high-frequency, low-amplitude irregularities (micro-serrations) along the entire span from the notch to the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edge displays a subtle convex curve from the median notch extending towards the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinct, localized clusters of heterogeneous, high-contrast pixels (white, brown, and tan) located exclusively at the extreme distal tips of both the left and right lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant physical encrustations and irregular organic buildup present on the far distal margins of both fluke lobes.
